# Focus

> Focus is a minimal, terminal-styled Pomodoro timer and task list for iPhone (iOS 26+), made by An Le. It is free and installed by sideloading (iloader or SideStore) with a free Apple ID, not through the App Store.

Focus looks like a terminal: monospace type, black background, no clutter. Run focus and break blocks, keep a short task list, and follow the timer from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. The app and this website are available in English and Vietnamese.

## Website

- [Home](https://sus1234trwtw.github.io/): what Focus is, features and screenshots
- [Install guide](https://sus1234trwtw.github.io/install.html): step-by-step sideloading with iloader or SideStore, on Windows or Mac

## Download

- [Latest release (IPA)](https://github.com/SuS1234trwtw/focus-timer/releases/latest): download the Focus IPA
- [SideStore source](https://github.com/SuS1234trwtw/focus-timer/releases/latest/download/source.json): add this URL in SideStore to install and get updates
- [Source code](https://github.com/SuS1234trwtw/focus-timer): GitHub repository

## Key features

- Pomodoro timer: focus and break sessions with custom lengths, sounds and haptics
- Task list: simple tasks, synced across your devices
- Live Activity and Dynamic Island: the running timer on the Lock Screen and in the Island
- Home Screen widgets
- Spotify: see and control what is playing (optional)
- Google Calendar: log finished focus blocks to a calendar named "Focus" (optional; uses only the calendar.app.created permission)
- English and Vietnamese
